Bug_Title: SA: Nonsensical self computation involving a variable (e.g., x & x) (SA_LOCAL_SELF_COMPUTATION)
Bug_Details:
This method performs a nonsensical computation of a local variable with another
reference to the same variable (e.g., x&x or x-x). Because of the nature
of the computation, this operation doesn't seem to make sense,
and may indicate a typo or a logic error. Double-check the computation.
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates nonsensical self computations by using 'x & x' and 'x - x', both of which are redundant operations that yield the same value or zero respectively. These computations do not make logical sense as they do not alter the value of x.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases trigger the bug by asserting that the result of the nonsensical computation should not match the expected incorrect return value. This assertion fails because the computation always yields the same value. For `showBug`, the result is always `x`, and for `showBug2`, the result is always `0`, leading to a failed test case.
